item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
✨ New Features

  • app: pinned apps, overflow group and configurable icon count (#22)
  • ui: add About screen showing version and license status (#3)

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • release: stable goes to both appcasts, scoped changelog, single upfront confirmation (#31)
  • sparkle: default SPARKLE_FEED_URL so local builds have a feed (#29)
  • appcast: do not emit sparkle:channel in appcast entries (#30)
  • ui: update status bar from emitted badge values (#21)
  • macos: release AXUIElement references to stop Dock reader leak (#2)

⚡ Performance

  • app: reduce refresh loop overhead and fix comparison docs (#19)

🔧 Improvements

  • xcode: adopt Xcode 27 recommended project settings (#28)

📚 Documentation

  • correct Badgeify features in comparison table (#18)
  • add competitor comparison, roadmap and performance principle (#15)

Full Changelog: https://github.com/mtxr/DockPulse/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
